title: Five more text models
summary:
The text model list grew while the image documentation shed a few outdated examples.

GPT-5 Nano, Claude 3.5 Haiku, OpenAI o3, DeepSeek R1 0528, and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite were added to the text model list, widening the choices for different kinds of requests.

GPT-5 Nano accepts images alongside text, and both it and Claude 3.5 Haiku support tools. The model update also added upstream identifiers for nova-fast and roblox-rp and cached-input pricing for nova-fast.

The README and website news dropped outdated GPT Image and tier announcements. Image API docs now describe image-to-image input for Kontext without GPT Image examples or the documented `transparent` parameter. This was a docs change, not an API change.
